# MongoDB Documentation

> Official MongoDB Documentation. Learn to store data in flexible documents, create an Atlas deployment, and use our tools and integrations.

- [Welcome to the MongoDB Docs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs//index.md): Official MongoDB Documentation. Learn to store data in flexible documents, create an Atlas deployment, and use our tools and integrations.
- [MongoDB Agent Skills](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/agent-skills.md): Learn about MongoDB Agent Skills and how to use them with AI coding agents.
- [Build with AI](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/build-with-ai.md): Use AI to build with MongoDB through MCP, documentation context, and more.
- [MongoDB with Claude](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/claude.md): Learn how to install the official MongoDB Claude Plugin and use MongoDB with Claude Code.
- [MongoDB with Codex](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/codex.md): Learn how to use MongoDB with Codex using the official MongoDB Codex Plugin.
- [Supported Platforms for MongoDB Community](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/community-platform-support.md): View the platforms and architectures supported by MongoDB Community Edition, including Linux, Windows, and macOS across the x86_64, arm64, ppc64le, and s390x architectures.
- [MongoDB with Cursor](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/cursor.md): Learn how to use MongoDB with Cursor by installing the MongoDB Cursor Plugin, which bundles the MongoDB MCP Server and agent skills for common MongoDB tasks.
- [Choose Your Deployment Environment](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/deployment.md): Determine which MongoDB product, supported platform, deployment environment, and methodology best suits your operational, scalability, and management requirements.
- [Development](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/development.md): Learn how to use MongoDB in your applications. Connect to databases, perform CRUD operations, optimize with indexes, and design data models.
- [Plan Your Enterprise Advanced Deployment](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/enterprise-advanced-deployment.md): Learn about the MongoDB Enterprise Advanced control plane, Ops Manager, MongoDB Agent, and MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes, and how they work together to run MongoDB at scale.
- [Supported Platforms for MongoDB Enterprise](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/enterprise-platform-support.md): View the platforms and architectures supported by MongoDB Enterprise Advanced, including Linux, Windows, and macOS across the x86_64, arm64, ppc64le, and s390x architectures.
- [MongoDB with Gemini](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/gemini.md): Learn how to use MongoDB with Gemini by installing the MongoDB Gemini Extension, which bundles the MongoDB MCP Server and agent skills for common tasks.
- [Generative AI FAQs](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/generative-ai-faq.md): Explore generative AI features in MongoDB, including query generation and visualization, powered by Azure OpenAI and Github Copilot.
- [Get Started](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/get-started.md): How to create an Atlas cluster, connect to it, and load sample data using the Atlas CLI and your preferred programming language.
- [MongoDB with C](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/c.md): Explore building applications with the MongoDB C driver, utilizing `libbson` and `libmongoc` for BSON document handling and database connectivity.
- [MongoDB with C++](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/cpp.md): Explore using the MongoDB C++ driver to build applications like engines, games, and GUIs with Atlas cloud database support.
- [MongoDB with C#](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/csharp.md): Explore using C# with MongoDB, including the .NET/C# driver, Entity Framework integration, and various libraries and extensions for application development.
- [MongoDB with Go](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/go.md): Explore building Go applications with MongoDB Atlas, utilizing OpenTelemetry and community integrations.
- [MongoDB with Java](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/java.md): Develop Java applications using Atlas with synchronous and asynchronous drivers, and integrate with Spring Data MongoDB for scalable solutions.
- [MongoDB with JavaScript](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/javascript.md): Explore JavaScript and TypeScript integrations with MongoDB, including Node.js driver features and support for MERN and MEAN stack applications.
- [MongoDB with Kotlin](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin.md): Develop server-side Kotlin applications using Atlas with coroutine-based and synchronous MongoDB drivers.
- [MongoDB with PHP](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/php.md): Build PHP applications using Atlas, PHP drivers, and integrations with frameworks like Laravel and Symfony.
- [MongoDB with Python](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python.md): Explore building applications with Python and MongoDB, utilizing drivers, frameworks, and libraries for robust and scalable solutions.
- [MongoDB with Ruby](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/ruby.md): Explore how to integrate MongoDB with Ruby on Rails applications using Mongoid, leveraging conventions similar to Active Record for data modeling.
- [MongoDB with Rust](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/rust.md): Explore how to develop Rust applications with MongoDB Atlas, using integrations like Rocket and Actix for enhanced performance and safety.
- [MongoDB with Scala](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/scala.md): Explore resources for building high-performance applications with Scala using the MongoDB Atlas cloud database and Scala driver.
- [Legacy Documentation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/legacy.md): Archived MongoDB documentation for products that have reached their end-of-life and are no longer supported.
- [Management](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/management.md): Explore our guides to learn about best practices and tools for effective database administration and management.
- [Preview Features](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/preview-features.md): Learn about the features and limitations of public and private preview programs
- [Tools, Migrators, and Connectors](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/tools-and-connectors.md): Find MongoDB tools and connectors by goal, including migrating from a relational database, syncing clusters, connecting BI tools, and managing self-managed deployments.
